data.name: Sample - Fortinet FortiRecon Brand Protection - 2.2.0
data.description: Sample playbooks for "Fortinet FortiRecon Brand Protection" connector. If you are planning to use any of the sample playbooks in your environment, ensure that you clone those playbooks and move them to a different collection, since the sample playbook collection gets deleted during connector upgrade and delete.

workflows.name: Get Code Repositories
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of code repository based on the filter criteria that you have specified.

workflows.name: Update Code Repo Status
workflows.description: Updates the status of the Code Repo record.

workflows.name: Get Social Media Threats
workflows.description: Retrieves list of social media threats based on the filter criteria that you have specified.

workflows.name: Get Rogue Apps
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of Rogue Apps based on the status and keywords that you have specified for the query; rogue apps are mobile applications trying to look like apps from trusted brands.

workflows.name: Update Social Media Threat Status
workflows.description: Updates the status of the Social Media Threat record.

routes.name: Start-> Update Social Media Threat Status

workflows.name: Get Original Domains Statistics
workflows.description: Retrieves the statistics of original domains threats based on the page number and the page size specified.

workflows.name: Get Rogue App By ID
workflows.description: Retrieves details of a rogue app based on the Rogue App ID that you have specified.

workflows.name: Add Resource Comment
workflows.description: Add Comment to the resources. Resouces includes: OPEN_BUCKETS, DOMAIN_THREATS, CODE_REPOS, SOCIAL_MEDIA_PROFILES

workflows.name: Get Resource Comments
workflows.description: Returns the list of comments for given resource for the specified organisation. Resources includes: OPEN_BUCKETS, DOMAIN_THREATS, CODE_REPOS, SOCIAL_MEDIA_PROFILES

workflows.name: Get Takedown Requests
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of takedown requests for rogue apps and typo domains for the given organization the filter criteria that you have specified.

workflows.name: Update Rogue App Status
workflows.description: Updates the status of the Rogue App record.

workflows.name: Get Tags
workflows.description: Retrieves the list of active tags.

workflows.name: Get Domain Threats
workflows.description: Retrieves list of code domain threats based on the filter criteria that you have specified.

workflows.description: Retrieves the statistics of open bucket exposures.
